sentences.en: The ferrum and copper level of hair and ending capillary were determined by XRF on the two groups of children with anemia and compared with normal level.

sentences.en: The contents of copper, ferrum. zinc, manganese and lithium were determined in the femoral bones of 60 normal dead futuses of 5 - 8 months by means of flame atomic absorption.
